reply: a term to fit the 10-parameter limit. The best result came from a nonlinear fit that was not submitted through the evaluator. It was a general model, roughly `a1·P + a2·P² + (b1·P + b2·P²)·e^(−kt) − A(1−e^(−mt)) + e + s·sin(wP+φ)`, with a saturating time-dependent constant and a periodic term in P.
